hooks.name: Spec task follow-through
hooks.description: After each spec task, keeps tasks.md, validation, PBT coverage, commit messages, and the Kiro usage log in sync.

action.prompt: A spec task just finished. Before moving on: (1) check off the task (and any finished sub-tasks) in that spec's tasks.md; (2) if the task produced or changed a graph file, run `.venv/bin/python scripts/validate_graph.py <file>` and fix any errors; (3) if the task implements a correctness property listed in the spec's design.md, make sure the matching Hypothesis test exists and passes; (4) in any commit message you propose, cite the requirement numbers from the task's `_Requirements:_` line; (5) add one row to the "Kiro usage log" table in docs/KIRO_USAGE.md describing what Kiro did for this task.
